title.narrative: Exit of National Tuberculosis Program of Turkmenistan from the Global Fund support by 2024 - Turkmenistan (01-Jul-2021-31-Dec-2024)

description.narrative: Turkmenistan, Tuberculosis, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Turkmenistan)This program has the following goals: To finalize the successful transition and strengthen the sustainability of the Global Fund investments in Turkmenistan through progressive government co-financing of all key interventions by 2024 and reaching sustainability and self-reliance of the National TB Program by 2025.. The objectives of this program are: To sustain the National TB response in the successful and complete transition to domestic funding. To ensure universal access to prevention, diagnosis, treatment and care services for people with drug-resistant TB leaving no one behind ¬†and apply people-centred strategic interventions during the transition period
